kubernetes:
# Fail2ban: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-fail2ban/blob/main/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - capability NET_ADMIN: Required for fail2ban to be able to modify iptables rules..
#   - capability NET_RAW: Required for fail2ban to be able to bind to any interface & use RAW sockets..
#   - network: host networking is required; hostNetwork is set and no Service is emitted.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fail2ban-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: fail2ban-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: fail2ban-var-log:ro
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fail2ban
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: fail2ban
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: fail2ban
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/fail2ban:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: fail2ban-env
        volumeMounts:
        - name: fail2ban-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: fail2ban-var-log:ro
          mountPath: /var/log:ro
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            add:
            - NET_ADMIN
            - NET_RAW
      hostNetwork: true
      volumes:
      - name: fail2ban-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: fail2ban-config
      - name: fail2ban-var-log:ro
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: fail2ban-var-log:ro
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
quadlet:
# fail2ban.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-fail2ban/blob/main/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Fail2ban (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/fail2ban:latest
ContainerName=fail2ban
AutoUpdate=registry
Network=host
AddCapability=NET_ADMIN
AddCapability=NET_RAW
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=VERBOSITY=-vv
Volume=/path/to/fail2ban/config:/config:Z
Volume=/var/log:/var/log:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/airsonic/log:/remotelogs/airsonic:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/apache2/log:/remotelogs/apache2:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/authelia/log:/remotelogs/authelia:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/emby/log:/remotelogs/emby:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/filebrowser/log:/remotelogs/filebrowser:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/homeassistant/log:/remotelogs/homeassistant:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/lighttpd/log:/remotelogs/lighttpd:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/nextcloud/log:/remotelogs/nextcloud:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/nginx/log:/remotelogs/nginx:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/nzbget/log:/remotelogs/nzbget:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/overseerr/log:/remotelogs/overseerr:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/prowlarr/log:/remotelogs/prowlarr:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/radarr/log:/remotelogs/radarr:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/sabnzbd/log:/remotelogs/sabnzbd:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/sonarr/log:/remotelogs/sonarr:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/unificontroller/log:/remotelogs/unificontroller:ro:Z
# Volume=/path/to/vaultwarden/log:/remotelogs/vaultwarden:ro:Z

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
